comment: The technique table. They fire on their own once their cooldown is up and there is energy for them, so the fight plays itself. 'img' is the picture each one draws.

skills.name: Iron Fist
skills.desc: The fist hardens for a breath. Every blow lands heavier.

skills.name: Stone Ward
skills.desc: Skin turns to stone. The blow slides off.

skills.name: Cloud Step
skills.desc: The body is not where the strike lands.

skills.name: Thunder Palm
skills.desc: A palm strike that finds the heart before the guard.

skills.name: Sword Rain
skills.desc: Three swords fall where the enemy is looking.

skills.name: Deep Breath
skills.desc: The dantian fills again. Qi returns to the limbs.
